job.job_description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, its our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies , and through our businesses including Trane and Thermo King , sustainability is not just how we do business it is our business. Do you dare to look at the worlds challenges and see impactful possibilities Do you want to contribute to making a better future If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging whats possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

Whats in it for you:

BrainBox AI is part of Trane Technologies and helps support its goal of creating smart, energy efficient buildings. Brainbox AI utilizes self adapted artificial intelligence technology to proactively optimize the energy consumption of one of the largest contributors to climate change.

Our AI engine supports a self operating building that requires no human intervention. Using deep learning, cloud based computing, and our proprietary process, our solution autonomously optimizes existing Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) control systems for maximum impact on energy consumption.

An exciting opportunity awaits the right candidate to be part of a team within a fast growing Artificial Intelligence company as an AI Controls Integrator on the Building Digitalization Team. As an AI Controls Engineer & Integrator, you will play a pivotal role in the delivery of the BBAI solution to our clients.

The role will be mainly focused on mapping clients data to fit BBAI internal standards. In addition, you will also be involved in deploying energy efficiency solutions in buildings. This position is for Chennai Location.

What you will do:

Use Python scripts, and front-end user interface to support the digitalization and development of different projects.

Test and deploy different algorithms for project deployment and share the report to different stakeholders.

Take ownership of supporting different teams in project handoff, algorithm deployment, and ensuring the timely completion of projects deployment.

Understand building hierarchy and point names and tags.

Engage cross-functionally with teams to facilitate building deployments and onboarding processes.

Understand Building HVAC designs and document information.

Work with standardized procedures for building digitalized deployment.

Support requests to update config and control changes needed for buildings.

Maintain thorough documentation of work processes and procedures.

Provide support for post-deployment handoff and contribute to the deployment of client value-add services.

Good communication skills

What you will bring:

Bachelor s degree in building or mechanical engineering, or technical degree in related field with 2 to 3 years of experience with building automation and HVAC control system

In-depth knowledge of various building HVAC equipment, demonstrating familiarity with the diverse range found in buildings.

Practical experience with DDC (Direct Digital Control), PLC (Programmable Logic Controller), or similar programming in BAS (Building Automation System) and HVAC control.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with building management system protocols, including but not limited to BACnet, Modbus, and Lon works is considered an asset.

Proficiency in Python and other programming languages is considered an asset.

Understanding of Basic Control Practices

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.
